name: Smith
about: Will sell you steel and tell you what is wrong with your sword, says it from behind a scarred leather apron with a war-hammer never racked far from his hand.
greetings: If it is bent I can see it from here.
Ore, tools, or an opinion. Pick one.
gossip: Good iron comes from the hills. Bad iron comes from people in a hurry.
A masterwork blade is a lucky day, not a technique. Anyone who says otherwise is selling.
Bring me meteoric and I will clear my week.
